info.title: Secrets service (internal)
info.description: INTERNAL contract between the API gateway and the secrets service. Not public: it is only reachable on the internal Docker network. Both services are tested against this file (services/gateway/test/contract.secrets.test.ts and services/secrets/test/contract.test.ts), so neither side can change it alone without failing CI. The gateway passes these responses straight through to clients, so every error code must also exist in the public API, and responses under /secrets are always Cache-Control: no-store. The service starts sealed: until an operator unseals it, every /secrets route answers 503 SECRETS_SEALED and /ready reports not_ready with a reason. Operator commands (init, unseal, seal) are not part of this API: they only exist on a Unix socket inside the secrets container. GET /internal/secrets/{name} is only for the gateway's proxy route (secret injection): no public route maps to it. /internal/file-keys/* are only for the storage service (encrypted storage) and need its token (INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN).

delete.summary: Crypto-shred the tenant (gateway only, when a workspace is deleted)
delete.description: Destroys the tenant's key and every secret and version, and remembers that the tenant was shredded (docs/decisions/0020): from then on its wrapped file keys can never be unwrapped (404) and no new key is ever made for it. Only while unsealed. Safe to call again. INTERNAL ONLY: no public gateway route maps to it.
